title: Step 3: hovering a session row turns it terracotta, and its grey second line and voice count become unreadable
what_happens: On hover the row background becomes the accent terracotta (lab L≈50) while the code, date and '3 voices' stay muted grey (L≈40): about 1.4:1 contrast. The dark title is about 3:1.
who_hurts: An admin moving the mouse down the list to find a session: the row under the pointer is the one they can't read.
suggested_fix: Use a light hover like the theme rows (hover:bg-muted/40) in session-row.tsx, or set text-accent-foreground on hover.
rule: general: WCAG 2.2 1.4.3; established pattern: theme rows on the session Overview use hover:bg-muted/40
